app.title: Relationship Audit
app.subtitle: Structural Dialogue: Not just chatting, but scrutinizing the connection.

startScreen.title: Relationship Audit
description: This is not a casual conversation.
It is a structural dialogue designed to surface needs, misunderstandings, and responsibilities.
Both parties must be willing to be honest, vulnerable, and accountable.

endScreen.title: audit complete
endScreen.subtitle: Take a deep breath. Acknowledge the courage it took to be here.

needs.name: Needs & Expectations
needs.description: What is missing? What is required?

truth.name: Fears & Truths
truth.description: The things we are afraid to say

questions.question: What do you need from me that you’re not getting?
In what specific way do you feel I take you for granted?
What is one thing I could do this week that would make you feel truly supported?
How do I fail to meet your expectations in our relationship?
What is a need of yours that you feel uncomfortable expressing to me?
Where in our relationship do you feel you are doing more of the heavy lifting?
If you could change one way I communicate with you, what would it be?
When do you feel most misunderstood by me?
What is a past hurt between us that you haven't fully let go of?
When I apologize, what is missing for you to feel it's sincere?
What is the most painful thing I have ever said to you?
In what situations do you feel I am not on your team?
What is a recurring conflict we have that you feel is unresolved?
When do you feel judged by me?
What are you afraid to ask me?
What is something you are pretending not to know about our relationship?
If we were to end our relationship today, what would be the reason?
What part of yourself do you feel you have to hide from me?
What hesitation do you have about our future together?
What is a secret you’ve kept from me to protect my feelings?
What is the hardest truth you have had to accept about me?
